lessons.title: It is essential that he be informed
lessons.title_uz: Subjunctive va rasmiy shart: were to, should, it is vital that
lessons.goal_uz: Rasmiy hujjat va inshoda ishlatiladigan subjunctive (It is essential that she be...) va "were to / should" bilan gipotetik shartlarni qo'llaysiz.

words.ex: It is imperative that we act now.
The contract stipulates that payment be made monthly.
The doctor recommended that he rest.
She insisted that the meeting be recorded.
The law contains a provision for emergencies.
All staff must comply with the rules.
In the event of fire, use the stairs.
Let's consider a hypothetical situation.

steps.title: Extract from a university regulation
steps.text:
Section 4: Academic integrity
4.1 It is essential that every student be familiar with the university's policy on plagiarism before submitting any assessed work.
4.2 The Examination Board recommends that suspected cases be reported to the Head of Department within five working days.
4.3 Should a student be found to have submitted work that is not their own, the work will be awarded a mark of zero.
4.4 Were the university to discover a second offence, it would reserve the right to suspend the student for up to one academic year.
4.5 The regulations stipulate that any student facing such action be given the opportunity to present their case in person.
steps.uz:
4-bo'lim: Akademik halollik
4.1 Har bir talaba baholanadigan ishni topshirishdan oldin universitetning plagiat bo'yicha siyosati bilan tanish bo'lishi shart.
4.2 Imtihon kengashi shubhali holatlar besh ish kuni ichida kafedra mudiriga xabar qilinishini tavsiya etadi.
4.3 Agar talaba o'ziga tegishli bo'lmagan ishni topshirgani aniqlansa, ishga nol ball qo'yiladi.
4.4 Agar universitet ikkinchi qoidabuzarlikni aniqlasa, talabani bir o'quv yiligacha chetlatish huquqini o'zida saqlab qoladi.
4.5 Qoidalarga ko'ra, bunday chora ko'rilayotgan har qanday talabaga o'z pozitsiyasini shaxsan bayon qilish imkoniyati berilishi shart.

steps.q: What happens after a first case of plagiarism?
steps.explain_uz: 4.3: "the work will be awarded a mark of zero".

steps.q: What right does every accused student have?
options: To present their case in person
steps.explain_uz: 4.5: "be given the opportunity to present their case in person".

steps.body_uz:
**1. Mandative subjunctive** — talab, tavsiya, zarurat ifodalovchi so'zlardan keyin **that + ega + fe'lning asosiy shakli** (barcha shaxslarda bir xil, -s yo'q!):
**recommend / insist / demand / suggest / propose / stipulate + that**: The board recommends that he **be** informed. She insisted that he **leave**. ("he leaves" emas!)
**It is essential / vital / imperative / crucial that** + ega + asosiy fe'l: It is vital that every student **attend**.
Inkor: that he **not be** told (do ishlatilmaydi).
Britaniya ingliz tilida **should** bilan ham bo'ladi: ...that he **should be** informed.
**2. Rasmiy shart (inversiya)**:
**Should + ega + fe'l** = If (ehtimoli kam): **Should** you require assistance, ... 
**Were + ega + to + fe'l** = If (gipotetik): **Were** the price **to** rise, demand would fall.
**Were + ega** (+ ot/sifat): **Were** I in your position, I would resign.

steps.prompt: Write a short set of formal regulations (5–6 points) for a library, school or workplace, using the subjunctive and formal conditionals.
steps.example:
Library regulations
1. It is essential that every visitor present a valid membership card at the entrance.
2. The management requests that mobile phones be switched to silent mode at all times.
3. Should a book be returned more than seven days late, a fine of 5,000 som will be charged.

lessons.title: Conduct research, pose a threat
lessons.goal_uz: Ingliz tilida qaysi so'zlar birga ishlatilishini (do research emas, conduct research) o'rganasiz — bu Writing'da Lexical Resource 8+ ning kaliti.

words.ex: The team conducted research in five countries.
Plastic waste poses a serious threat to marine life.
It is too early to draw any conclusions.
Parents bear responsibility for their children's safety.
Teachers play a pivotal role in society.
The campaign aims to raise awareness of diabetes.
The government must address the issue of housing.
There is widespread concern about the economy.

steps.title: Same ideas, stronger collocations
steps.text:
Version A (band 6): Scientists did a lot of research about plastic in the ocean. They found that plastic makes a big danger for fish. Governments have a big responsibility to do something about this problem, and we need to make people know more about it.

Version B (band 8+): Scientists have conducted extensive research into plastic pollution in the oceans. Their findings suggest that plastic poses a severe threat to marine ecosystems. Governments bear considerable responsibility for addressing this issue, and public campaigns could play a pivotal role in raising awareness of its consequences.
steps.uz:
A varianti (6 ball): Olimlar okeandagi plastik haqida ko'p tadqiqot qilishdi. Ular plastik baliqlar uchun katta xavf yaratishini topishdi. Hukumatlarning bu muammo bo'yicha nimadir qilish uchun katta javobgarligi bor va biz odamlarga bu haqda ko'proq bildirishimiz kerak.

B varianti (8+ ball): Olimlar okeanlardagi plastik ifloslanish bo'yicha keng ko'lamli tadqiqotlar o'tkazgan. Ularning natijalari plastik dengiz ekotizimlariga jiddiy xavf tug'dirishini ko'rsatadi. Hukumatlar bu muammoni hal qilishda katta mas'uliyat zimmasida va jamoatchilik kampaniyalari uning oqibatlari haqida xabardorlikni oshirishda hal qiluvchi rol o'ynashi mumkin.

steps.q: Which collocation in Version B replaces "makes a big danger"?
What is the main difference between A and B?
options: B uses precise, natural word combinations.
steps.explain_uz: G'oyalar bir xil — B'da to'g'ri kollokatsiyalar.

steps.body_uz:
Kollokatsiya — ona tilida so'zlashuvchilar **odatda birga ishlatadigan** so'z juftliklari. Grammatik qoida yo'q — ularni **yodlash** kerak.
O'zbekchadan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri tarjima ko'pincha xato beradi:
**tadqiqot qilmoq** → do research ✗ (norasmiy) → **conduct / carry out research** ✓
**xulosa qilmoq** → make a conclusion ✗ → **draw / reach a conclusion** ✓
**xavf tug'dirmoq** → make a danger ✗ → **pose a threat / risk** ✓
**qaror qabul qilmoq** → take/make a decision ✓ (**reach** a decision — uzoq muhokamadan keyin)
**Fe'l + ot**: address / tackle an issue · meet a need / demand · exert pressure · undergo changes · reach a consensus
**Sifat + ot**: heavy traffic (strong traffic ✗) · strong evidence · widespread concern · a sharp decline · a vital role · high unemployment (big unemployment ✗)
**Ravish + sifat**: highly unlikely · deeply concerned · bitterly disappointed · widely accepted
Maslahat: yangi so'zni yolg'iz emas, **sherigi bilan** yozib oling.

It is highly unlikely that prices will fall.
There is strong evidence that exercise improves mood.

steps.prompt_uz: "Ijtimoiy tarmoqlarning yoshlarga ta'siri" mavzusida Task 2 paragrafi yozing (120+ so'z). Kamida 6 ta kollokatsiyadan foydalaning va ularning tagiga chizish uchun **...** bilan belgilang.
steps.prompt: Write a Task 2 body paragraph about the impact of social media on young people. Use at least six strong collocations and mark them with **...**.
steps.example: Social media undoubtedly **plays a pivotal role** in the lives of young people today, but there is **widespread concern** about its effects on mental health. Researchers have **conducted extensive research** into this area, and many have **drawn the conclusion** that excessive use is linked to anxiety and low self-esteem. There is **strong evidence**, for instance, that constant comparison with idealised images **poses a serious threat** to teenagers' confidence. Nevertheless, it would be simplistic to blame technology alone. Schools and parents **bear considerable responsibility** for teaching young people to use these platforms wisely, and well-designed campaigns could help **raise awareness** of the risks without denying the genuine benefits of online connection.

lessons.title: So do I, if not
lessons.goal_uz: Takrorlardan qochib, matnni silliq bog'laysiz: do so, so / not, one(s), that of, ellipsis — Coherence and Cohesion 8+ uchun.

words.ex: Good cohesion makes an essay easy to follow.
Avoid unnecessary repetition.
Of tea and coffee, I prefer the former.
Of tea and coffee, I prefer the latter.
Ali and Vali are 20 and 22, respectively.
This is not always the case.
He apologised, and she did likewise.

steps.title: Before and after editing
steps.text:
Before: Some people think that governments should fund the arts. Other people think that governments should not fund the arts. People who think governments should fund the arts argue that the arts improve quality of life. I agree that the arts improve quality of life, but I do not think governments should spend more money on the arts than governments spend on healthcare.

After: Some people believe that governments should fund the arts, while others believe they should not. Those in favour argue that the arts improve quality of life. I agree that this is the case, but I do not think governments should spend more on culture than they do on healthcare.
steps.uz:
Tahrirdan oldin: Ba'zi odamlar hukumatlar san'atni moliyalashtirishi kerak deb o'ylashadi. Boshqa odamlar hukumatlar san'atni moliyalashtirmasligi kerak deb o'ylashadi. Hukumatlar san'atni moliyalashtirishi kerak deb o'ylaydigan odamlar san'at hayot sifatini yaxshilaydi deb ta'kidlaydi...

Tahrirdan keyin: Ba'zilar hukumatlar san'atni moliyalashtirishi kerak deb hisoblasa, boshqalar kerak emas deb hisoblaydi. Tarafdorlar san'at hayot sifatini yaxshilaydi deb ta'kidlaydi. Men bu haqiqat ekaniga qo'shilaman, lekin hukumatlar madaniyatga sog'liqni saqlashdan ko'ra ko'proq pul sarflashi kerak deb o'ylamayman.

steps.q: In the edited version, what does "they should not" replace?
options: governments should not fund the arts

steps.q: What does "this is the case" refer to?
options: The arts improve quality of life.
steps.explain_uz: this is the case = **the arts improve quality of life**.

steps.body_uz:
**1. Fe'l iborasi o'rniga**: **do so / do the same / do likewise**: Many students want to study abroad, but few can afford **to do so**.
**2. Gap o'rniga — so / not**: Will prices rise? — I think **so**. / I hope **not**. ("I don't hope" ✗) · **If so, ... / If not, ...**
**3. Ot o'rniga — one / ones**: This essay is better than the previous **one**.
**4. Qiyoslashda — that of / those of**: The population of Tashkent is larger than **that of** Samarkand. ("than Samarkand" — mantiqan xato: aholini shahar bilan solishtirib bo'lmaydi!)
**5. Ellipsis — yordamchi fe'lda to'xtash**: She can speak Arabic, but I **can't**. · Some agree, while others **do not**.
**6. Ikki narsaga ishora**: **the former** (birinchisi) / **the latter** (ikkinchisi); **respectively** — mos ravishda.
**this / such + umumlovchi ot**: **This trend**, **Such measures**, **This approach** — oldingi butun g'oyani bog'laydi.

examples.en: The salaries of doctors are higher than those of teachers.
Is the museum open on Mondays? If not, we'll go on Tuesday.
examples.uz: Muzey dushanba kunlari ochiqmi? Agar yo'q bo'lsa, seshanba boramiz.

steps.prompt_uz: Quyidagi takrorga to'la matnni substitution va ellipsis yordamida qayta yozing (80+ so'z): "Some students prefer studying alone. Other students prefer studying in groups. Students who prefer studying alone say that studying alone helps them concentrate. Students who prefer studying in groups say that studying in groups is more motivating. I think studying in groups is more motivating, but I think studying alone is better before exams."
steps.prompt: Rewrite the repetitive paragraph using substitution, ellipsis and reference words.
steps.example: Some students prefer to study alone, while others prefer to work in groups. The former claim that solitude helps them concentrate, whereas the latter find collaboration more motivating. In my experience, both views have some merit. I agree that group study is more stimulating, particularly when tackling difficult concepts; however, I believe that studying independently is more effective in the final days before an exam, when concentration matters more than discussion. Students would therefore benefit from combining the two approaches rather than relying exclusively on either.
